facts.fact: Legal 500 (Ibrachy & Dermarkar) says personal data may not leave Egypt without prior authorisation from the Personal Data Protection Center, under Executive Regulations issued November 2025 with a grace period to 1 November 2026.
facts.system: Executive Regulations of Law 151 of 2020, transfer authorisation

note: No dated publication of a country list, model terms or decision on a transfer is stated.
